worker.outcomeSummary: Rewrote migrateConfig in src/config.ts (only file changed, committed in the worktree). It now (1) requires a plain-object input and rejects unknown keys, (2) resolves every documented spelling synonym to its one logical setting and rejects documents that name a setting more than once with disagreeing values while accepting agreeing duplicates, (3) validates values the document actually provides (non-empty name/endpoint, integer retries >= 0, integer timeoutMs >= 1) before (4) applying defaults only for settings the document omits.
